name: ca.dnart.b2umaterialmaster

samples.description: An interactive scene demonstrating liquid advection, solid materials, and runtime RSUV control.

description:
A free technical art pipeline for creating textureless vertex-data and LUT-driven materials in Unity. Integrates directly with Blender to paint materials directly on meshes. 

Key Features:
▪SRP and GRD batching support for all materials
▪Assign materials directly onto faces in Blender
▪Create flowing liquids with CPU accessible flow vectors to push objects
▪Have per object control of several values through Renderer Set User Values (RSUV)
▪Use mutliple performance profiles
▪Use mutliple different palettes to change the look of the entire scene
▪Animate various B2U features through scripting or the Unity Animator
▪Volumetric optics for liquids and crystals
▪Fullscreen edge detection
▪Fullscreen stylization
▪Fullscreen recoloring
▪Fullscreen status effects

And more! Please look at the documentation to see all available features and guides on how to use the package.
